project.title: The Last Cup
project.style: cinematic, warm Ethiopian heritage, painterly realism, earthy brown and gold palette

music.prompt: Warm reflective instrumental underscore, no vocals, gentle plucked texture and soft percussion

shots.reason: Establish distance and loneliness before memory begins.
shots.image_prompt: A young Ethiopian adult alone beside a window in a small modern apartment at dusk, distant city lights, reflective cinematic composition
shots.narration_am: ከቤት ርቀን ስንኖር፣ አንዳንድ ትዝታዎች ወደ እኛ ይመጣሉ።
shots.subtitle_en: Far from home, some memories find their way back.

shots.reason: A familiar smell triggers the memory.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of coffee beans in a traditional Ethiopian roasting pan, warm amber light, hands sorting beans
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan across the coffee beans
shots.narration_am: የቡና ሽታ አንድ የተለመደ ቀንን ወደ ትዝታ ይቀይራል።
shots.subtitle_en: The scent of coffee turns an ordinary day into a memory.

shots.reason: Introduce the grandmother and ritual as the emotional center.
shots.image_prompt: Elder Ethiopian woman in traditional white netela seated near a low table, peaceful expression, soft morning sunlight
shots.subtitle_en: My grandmother prepared coffee with patience.

shots.reason: Show the process and care through a close-up.
shots.image_prompt: Hands pouring water into a traditional Ethiopian jebena beside small cups and a woven grass tray, warm earthy tones
shots.motion_prompt: Slow tilt following the stream of water
shots.narration_am: የእያንዳንዱ እንቅስቃሴ ትርጉም ነበረው፤ መጠበቅ፣ ማካፈል፣ መሰብሰብ።
shots.subtitle_en: Every gesture meant something: wait, share, gather.

shots.reason: Visualize community and conversation around the ceremony.
shots.image_prompt: Family members sitting together around an Ethiopian coffee ceremony, candid warm smiles, cups being shared, softly lit home
shots.narration_am: በቡና ዙሪያ ቃላት ይቀላሉ፣ ልቦች ግን ይቀራረባሉ።
shots.subtitle_en: Around coffee, words soften and hearts draw closer.

shots.reason: Connect the ritual with a remembered lesson.
shots.image_prompt: Steam rising from freshly poured coffee in a tiny ceramic cup, sun rays crossing the steam, serene close-up
shots.narration_am: እሷ ሁልጊዜ፣ ትንሽ ብርሃን እንኳ ጨለማን ያሸንፋል ትል ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: She always said: even a little light can overcome darkness.

shots.reason: Return to the present as the protagonist recreates the ritual.
shots.image_prompt: Young Ethiopian adult preparing coffee alone in an apartment, arranging cups and beans, soft evening golden light
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera push toward hands and cup
shots.narration_am: ዛሬ እኔም ቡና አዘጋጃለሁ፣ የእሷን ድምፅ በውስጤ እየሰማሁ።
shots.subtitle_en: Now I prepare coffee too, hearing her voice within me.

shots.reason: The ritual becomes an act of carrying heritage forward.
shots.image_prompt: Young person holding a small Ethiopian coffee cup near a window, gentle smile, city outside, contemplative portrait
shots.narration_am: ባህል ወደ ኋላ የምንተወው አይደለም፤ ከእኛ ጋር የሚጓዝ ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: Heritage is not something we leave behind. It travels with us.

shots.reason: Close with a shared cup, emphasizing continuity and belonging.
shots.image_prompt: Two hands sharing a small coffee cup across a table, traditional woven mat, intimate warm cinematic lighting
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle slow zoom toward the cup
shots.narration_am: አንድ ኩባያ ቡና፣ ብዙ ትዝታዎችን ይዞ ይመጣል።
shots.subtitle_en: One cup can carry a thousand memories.

shots.reason: End on the film title and disclosure.
shots.image_prompt: Warm dark background with a glowing Ethiopian coffee cup silhouette and soft steam, minimal cinematic end card
shots.narration_am: ቤት ሁልጊዜ የምንመለስበት ቦታ አይደለም፤ አንዳንድ ጊዜ የምንሸከመው ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: Home is not always where we return. Sometimes, it is what we carry.
